description: Renovate on GitHub (Mend app) with the shared preset; below only what vimmary adds to it.

customManagers.description: golangci-lint is pinned for the prebuilt binary in ci.yml (and the weekly gate in deploy.yml) and for the go install in scripts/setup. One dependency, so all pins move in one PR.

packageRules.description: tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/vite are released together and share the lockfile.
pgvector is pinned in compose.test.yaml, compose.e2e.yaml, docker-compose.yml and the test services of ci.yml and deploy.yml; production pins it in the homelab repo.

goldmark stays on v1. The v2 module (github.com/yuin/goldmark/v2) changes the import path, which needs gomodUpdateImportPaths rather than gomodTidy, and its API: after rewriting the import in internal/feed/atom.go the build fails with `undefined: goldmark.New` and `undefined: goldmark.Markdown` at three call sites (measured 2026-09-07, go 1.27.1). This is a code migration for that file, not a dependency update.
